conventions.units: metres, +Y up, north = -Z (identical in the web build, glTF and Godot)
conventions.matrix: 16 floats, column-major (three.js Matrix4.elements): basis columns x=[0,1,2] y=[4,5,6] z=[8,9,10], origin=[12,13,14] — see meta_util.gd mat16()
conventions.refs: {level: "<node name in level.glb>"} | {instance: "<instances[].name>"} | {instance, node: "<path inside res://assets/models/<model>.glb>", surface?}
conventions.colors: srgb = hex as authored in three (use for StandardMaterial3D.albedo_color), linear = three.js working values

lockedBox.lock.note: open = shackle pops (0.18 s, outBack) then the lock falls onto the console (0.5 s, see anim.padlock); close = reset

powerBox.lever.note: open = ON (initial state); setOn(on) flips it and calls world.set_power(on)

lockedBox.lid.note: opening also pops the padlock off (lockedBox.lock)

fan.note: speed += (target - speed) * min(1, dt * rate); blades.rotation.y += speed * dt

grandfatherClock.formula: hand.rotation.z (Euler XYZ, other axes kept) = (PI/2 - fraction * 2PI) - a0 ; hours: fraction = (h % 12) / 12, minutes: (m % 60) / 60; clue digit d: hours = d, minutes = 0

alarmClock.formula: node.quaternion = axisAngle(+Z, angle - a0) * base ; angle = PI/2 - fraction * 2PI (second hand ticks with an outBack ease over 0.09 s); starts at 03:07:12

rockingChair.formula: th = amp * sin(2PI/1.75 * t), amp 0.11 (0.9 s ease-in, 2.2 s decay); pivot.rotation.x = th; pivot.position.z = R * th

fallen.note: local to the lock parent (box frame, real metres)

oldCrt.note: flickers ~1.9 s when power comes back (ExtraProps.crtFlicker)

pullChain.formula: rotation.z = sin(t*8.2)*kick + sin(t*1.3)*0.006; rotation.x = sin(t*7.7+1.3)*kick*0.55; kick decays exp(-0.35 t), min 0.012

ceilingBowl.note: emissive bowl of the ceiling fan light (lighting module drives it)

doorStrip.note: emissive light strip under the upstairs door

upperHall.note: visible only while door.upstairs is open (t > 0.002)
